description:
Estimates how many decision-makers fit a business's offer.

    Returns the roles, places, industries and company sizes searched; the total
    count; five real example people (names blurred, companies unnamed) with a
    fit score; the buying signals Deberli tracks for that market; and a link
    that opens the full list in Deberli. Use it when the user asks who to sell
    to, how big their market is, or where to find customers or leads.
    Read-only. Takes 30-90 seconds.

brief.description: One or two sentences: what the business sells and to whom. Give this or website.
brief.title: Brief

market.description: Country or region the business sells in, e.g. United Kingdom. Without it the count covers every country.
market.title: Market

website.description: The business's website, e.g. acme.com. Give this or brief.
website.title: Website
